title: The World Beneath
description: The world beneath is a vanilla-friendly mod to enhance the caves of minecraft!
body:
![The World Beneath large logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/58114728af93bca88de98a2ee3ad8cb152129f0a_0.webp)

The World Beneath is a vanilla-friendly mod that aims to expand the caves of minecraft adding five new cave biomes in the underground, each cave has a purpose to be explored and discovered.

(trailer coming soon)


> **_New caves_**

**Glowing Caverns**: Luminous caves full of glowing mushrooms that naturally light up the surroundings. They only generate beneath Mushroom Islands, creating a bioluminescent biome.

**Rusted Depths**: Oxidized depths filled with burnt stone, lava and a new ore: the ferrosite, can be used for decoration and hand drills. The rusted depths mainly generate in hot and desert regions.

**Overgrowth Grotto**: A dense underground jungle packed with giant toxic mushrooms, poisonous vegetation, and humid environments.

**Frostbound Chasm**: Icy caves featuring glowing ice trees and delicate crystal flowers that illuminate the cold surroundings.

**Acid Catacombs**: Corrosive caves filled with acid lakes and a unique radioactive mineral.

_**Each biome has its own unique mineral.**_


------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

> **_Mushroom Caverns_**

The mushroom fields now got a new upgrade, you can find some new glowing mushrooms below it and you can survive if you are starving or exploring.

![Glowing Caverns](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2b326ae7b25331a978c7860e5afef9e6367669d5.webp)

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

> **_Rusted Depths_**

The rusted depths is a cave filled up with lava and charred rock, here you can find ferrosite, a mineral similar to the copper and iron that can be useful for decoration, hand drills and special tools!

![Rusted Depths](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e20dac1eafdf84eb5ead1a69bf6e7039e1b8ca7e_0.webp)

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

> **_Overgrowth Grotto_**

The overgrowth grotto is a underground jungle with big toxic mushrooms, vegetation, and warm environments. You can find 2 new crops: the fiber and maqui berries. fiber can be useful for decoration and ropes. With ropes and scarlet you can create the grappling hook.

![Overgrowth Grotto](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c8c90d7ce1279d1363eadac1a71e2236b870c99b_0.webp)

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

> **_Frostbound Chasm_**

The frostbound chasm is a icy cave with crystal trees with the gleam wood set and crystal flowers. you can find in here the sapphire, a bright blue gem to create the sapphire armor set and the builder's gauntlet.

![Frostbound Chasm](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6770c2e8903046f6ca157bb39250e670a2a8a214.jpeg)

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

> **_Acid Catacombs_**

The acid catacombs is an underground biome made up of acid, rock pillars, and deposits of thorium, a rare green mineral. Thorium is a valuable resource that can be used to craft thorium bombs, grenade launcher and reinforced cinder, providing new options for combat and destruction.

![Acid Catacombs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/de34ed0e68616db69ba8e4772aeaab440e23564b_0.webp)

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
